conflict_synopsis.core_view: Australian housing/labor slowdown plus broadening G10 tightening is not in AUDUSD, so the remaining risk-off expression is short AUD versus USD.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Further AU housing/labor deterioration and AU-US 2Y compression strip the AUD high-yielder bid.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: Australian labor/housing stabilize, AU-US front-end re-widens, and global policy reopens an easing path.

remit: strongest defensive, slowdown, stress or risk-off FX expression
stance_summary: Global tightening is still broadening into a housing-and-labor slowdown that AUDUSD has not paid for, so the cleanest remaining risk-off asymmetry is short AUD versus defensive USD.

catalysts: Further Australian housing, labor or confidence deterioration
Another G10 hawkish surprise or energy-pass-through print
trade.invalidation: Mechanism fails if Australian labor/housing stabilize or re-accelerate, AU-US front-end re-widens in AUD's favor, and global policy reopens a credible easing path while AUDUSD stays bid versus other high-beta FX.
trade.mispricing: AUDUSD remains resilient (ECB 18 Sep 2026 research/reference 0.7120, 1m +0.20%, 1y percentile 76.4) despite NSW stamp-duty receipts -24% y/y, housing turnover -18%, AU labor 47.8, and AU-US 2Y only +25.9bp after compression.
principal_risks: Saudi Oman workaround fades the energy-inflation tail
China-demand rescue keeps commodity FX bid
Short AUDUSD pays residual AU-US 2Y premium
trade.thesis: Australia's tightening channel is already biting in housing and labor while AUDUSD still trades as if global risk appetite and AUD rate support can continue. Fed, BoJ and a hawkish BoE hold have broadened higher-for-longer into the commodity-FX complex. NZDUSD already sold; CAD still has an energy terms-of-trade buffer. Remaining downside asymmetry therefore sits in AUD versus USD.
why_now: Verified new information after the already >90% priced Fed hike is the broadening of global tightening: BoJ hiked 25bp to 1.25% and BoE held 6-3 with three hike votes.
Australian housing is a live transmission channel: stamp-duty and turnover collapsing while home values are already down more than 7% from peak.
AUDUSD has not paid that tax, unlike NZDUSD (1m -3.90%).
AU-US 2Y compressed 12.5bp on the latest common observation, removing the relative-rate excuse for holding AUD versus USD.
